All 372 source word occurrences are preserved in exact order and spelling: 328 eligible and 44 explicitly excluded occurrences. The exclusions comprise 39 sound/action-description occurrences, one spelling hold (source haller versus the standard hâl sense), and four incomplete-speech occurrences (na three times and the interrupted düş). Fragmented colloquial syntax, including Pepe'nin dükkânı, Gözleri de aynı sen and Memo's changing narrative perspective, is explained without adding missing endings or treating every nonformal construction as a spelling error. Primary Turkish references support the dialect forms, the causative and the hospitality idiom çaylar şirketten; the TDK orthographic distinction grounds the explicit haller hold.
